description: Questions the Nimbus help centre does NOT answer, for refusal tests (M5/M6). Mostly near-misses: topics close to an article but not covered. Rule: no question may be answered by a closed list in the articles (e.g. 'Can I pay with Bitcoin?' is answerable: the payment article lists every accepted method). Checked three ways: `absentTerms` must not appear in any article (unit test), the top passages from vector and keyword search are saved by the eval, and a human reviews them (docs/eval/unanswerable-check.md).

questions.question: Can I buy extra storage on top of the 2 TB in my Personal plan without changing plans?
questions.why: Plans list fixed storage amounts and upgrading between plans; no add-on storage is mentioned.

questions.question: Do teachers or school staff get a discount?
questions.why: Discounts exist for students (Personal) and registered non-profits (Business); nothing about teachers or staff.

questions.question: Can I transfer my whole Nimbus account to someone else, like a family member?
questions.why: Shared-folder ownership, a departing employee's files and a Family plan can be transferred; transferring a personal account is not covered.

questions.question: What's the maximum number of people I can invite to a single shared folder?
questions.why: Roles and invitations are described, but no limit on members per shared folder.

questions.question: Can I protect a file request with a password?
questions.why: File requests have deadlines; passwords exist for sharing links only. Password protection for file requests is not mentioned.

questions.question: How do I change the language the Nimbus app is displayed in?
questions.why: Only the languages of the support team are listed, not app display languages.

questions.question: Does the web app have a dark mode?
questions.why: Not mentioned anywhere.

questions.question: Can I pause my subscription for a few months instead of cancelling it?
questions.why: Cancelling, undoing a cancellation and changing plans are covered; pausing a subscription is not. ("Pause" only appears for syncing.)

questions.question: Is there a free trial of the Business plan?
questions.why: Not mentioned.

questions.question: Will my free account be deleted if I don't sign in for a year?
questions.why: Only deliberate account deletion is described; no inactivity policy.

questions.question: Is there a Nimbus widget for my phone's home screen?
questions.why: Not mentioned.

questions.question: Does Nimbus scan my files for viruses or malware?
questions.why: Antivirus appears only as third-party software slowing sync, and executable previews are disabled; scanning by Nimbus is not stated.

questions.question: Can I access my Nimbus files over WebDAV or FTP?
questions.why: Only the REST API, apps and integrations are described.

questions.question: Can I edit a PDF in Nimbus, for example to fill in a form or sign it?
questions.why: PDFs can be previewed and documents scanned to PDF; editing Office files is via Microsoft 365 or Google Docs. Editing PDFs is not mentioned.

questions.question: Is Nimbus HIPAA compliant for storing medical records?
questions.why: Only ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II and a DPA are mentioned.

questions.question: How many computers and phones can I connect to one account?
questions.why: Devices can be listed and signed out; no device limit is stated.

questions.question: Do I get free storage for inviting friends to Nimbus?
questions.why: No referral programme is mentioned.

questions.question: Can I print a document straight from the Nimbus mobile app?
questions.why: Not mentioned.

questions.question: Can I limit how much bandwidth the desktop app uses when uploading?
questions.why: Not mentioned (the API's request limit is unrelated).

questions.question: Is there a limit on how many sharing links I can create?
questions.why: Not mentioned.

questions.question: How do I merge two Nimbus accounts into one?
questions.why: Not mentioned.

questions.question: Can I use Nimbus to host a website?
questions.why: Not mentioned.

questions.question: How do I reset the password for my Google account?
questions.why: Off-topic but close: the article covers Nimbus passwords and "Continue with Google" sign-in, not Google's own password reset.

questions.question: What will the weather be like in London tomorrow?
questions.why: Off-topic.

questions.question: Can you recommend a good laptop for video editing?
questions.why: Off-topic.

questions.question: Can I sync my Nimbus files to a NAS drive like a Synology?
questions.why: Only Windows, macOS and Linux desktop apps are described; NAS devices are not mentioned.

questions.question: Can I schedule a file to be deleted automatically on a certain date?
questions.why: Links can expire and the trash empties after 30 or 90 days; scheduled deletion of files is not mentioned.

questions.question: Is there a Nimbus app for Apple Watch or smart TVs?
questions.why: Only iPhone, iPad and Android phones and tablets are mentioned.

questions.question: Do you have an office where I can get help in person?
questions.why: Support channels are online (help centre, email, chat, phone); no in-person help is mentioned.

questions.question: Is there a tool to import all my files from Google Drive into Nimbus?
questions.why: Integrations open Google Docs and connect via Zapier; importing or migrating from another storage service is not mentioned.
